name: Load frontend assets from the app root
covers: PWA manifest loading without malformed relative URLs
description: Verifies the production app loads its frontend bundle, stylesheet and manifest from the MECHAT subdomain root.
steps: Open the deployed MECHAT URL on a mobile viewport
Wait for the frontend to initialize
Check the JavaScript bundle, stylesheet and manifest network requests
expected: The MECHAT page initializes and its JavaScript, CSS and manifest load successfully without malformed URLs or 404 responses.

name: Sign in and register a local device identity
covers: Appwrite health check without serial schema timeout
description: A signed-in account creates a device key pair, registers its public key, and confirms the existing Appwrite schema is reachable.
steps: Sign in to MECHAT
Wait for device setup
Reload the app
expected: The same local device identity remains registered, the private key is not uploaded, and the Appwrite health check completes without rebuilding every table.

name: Send a direct encrypted message to another device
covers: direct AES-GCM encryption with JSON-encoded Appwrite public keys
Appwrite offline queue and canonical shared conversation ID
chunked client-side encrypted Appwrite Storage upload
description: Actor A sends encrypted text and an encrypted Appwrite Storage attachment to Actor B; Actor B decrypts the message and downloads the original file without browser message-history persistence.
setup: Register Actor A and Actor B with devices.
steps: Actor A adds Actor B; the contact is saved for both accounts and appears after reload
Actor A opens the direct chat with Actor B
Actor A sends a message
Actor B opens and keeps the chat active while automatic inbox polling runs
Actor B confirms the new message appears without manually reloading
Actor A selects a 2 MB image attachment and waits for the encrypted upload to finish
Actor B opens the received attachment and downloads it
expected: Actor A's contact remains after reload; Actor B also sees Actor A in contacts; both accounts use the same canonical direct conversation ID; Actor B automatically receives and decrypts the text message, sees the attachment filename, and downloads a file whose bytes match the original image.

name: Create a group with per-device wrapped encryption keys
covers: sender device identification in wrapped keys
description: An admin creates an encrypted group and a member can locate the creator device and unwrap the group key.
setup: Register Actor A and Actor B with active devices.
steps: Actor A creates a group containing Actor B
Actor B opens the group
Actor A sends an encrypted group message
expected: Group creation exports the temporary AES key for device wrapping, each wrapped key identifies its sender device, and Actor B decrypts the group message locally.

name: Establish and end a WebRTC audio/video call
description: Two users exchange call signalling and media, then release tracks when the call ends.
setup: Register Actor A and Actor B on separate devices and grant microphone/camera permission.
steps: Actor A starts a video call
Actor B answers the incoming call
Actor A ends the call
expected: A WebRTC call connects when the network permits the configured ICE path and all local media tracks stop when ended.

name: Enforce private inbox and group access on mobile
covers: service worker does not cache API responses
description: An unauthorized client cannot fetch another account's messages or a group inbox, and API responses bypass the service-worker cache.
steps: Open MECHAT on a mobile viewport
Sign in with a registered account
Attempt to access a conversation without valid membership
expected: The backend rejects unauthorized access, no plaintext message is returned, and /api/ responses are never written to the service-worker cache.

name: Review active and reserved storage providers
covers: Appwrite remains the active encrypted attachment storage provider
provider credentials are not exposed in the client
description: Verifies the settings page clearly distinguishes the configured Appwrite provider from the two reserved providers awaiting credentials.
steps: Sign in to MECHAT
Open Settings & devices
Review the Storage Providers section
expected: Appwrite is labelled Active; TeraBox and Icedrive are labelled Reserved and explain that credentials are not configured. No secret values are displayed.
